tei:div.tei:p: zha lu lo chen chos skyong bzang po'i lo rgyus/

༄༅/ /zha lu lo chen chos skyong bzang po ni/ 'gos khug pa lha btsas dang*/ 'gos chos grub/ lo tsā ba gzhon nu dpal rnams 'khrungs pa'i gdung rigs las yab dpon bsam 'grub dpal bzang dang*/ yum rin chen chos 'dzom gyi sras su lcags mo bya lor 'khrungs/ zha lu legs rgyal las bri klog brda sbyor sogs bslab/ chu rta lor 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog bzang po la rab tu byung*/ rin chen chos skyong bzang por btags/ dpal 'khor chos sder bzhugs/ slob dpon ting 'dzin 'od zer las bsdus gra dang*/ 'dul ba/ shes phyin sogs bslab/ chos rje bsod grags pa las/ mdo sde rgyan dang 'byed gnyis bslab/ kun rigs lugs dang*/ dus 'khor rgyud 'grel/ dol po pa'i ri chos sogs kyang mkhas par bslab/ zha lu ri phug gi dus mchod skabs byams chos la bshad pa mdzad pas dge bshes kun ha las pa lta bur gyur/ zha lu legs rgyal las sgra ka lā pa'i ri mo dang sdeb sbyor/ snyan ngag rnams zhus/ 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog bzang po la jo lugs dus 'khor sbyor drug gi smin khrid zhus/ gzhan yang mdo dang rgyud dang rgyud 'grel sogs shin tu mang po gsan/ kun dga' dbang phyug las lam 'bras dang sa lugs kyi dbang khrid du ma gsan/ stag lo shes rab rin chen las dus 'khor dbang dang sems 'grel skor gsum sogs gsan/ me khyi lor/ chos rje don grub grags pa las bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i sdom pa nod/ yang stag lo la/ 'dus pa zhabs lugs/ sgrol ma lha bcu bdun sogs dang*/ sa sde dang sdom gnyis sogs mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs du ma'i dbang lung khrid sogs zhus/ dpal lding lo tsā ba grags pa blo gros las tsān+d+ra pa'i ri mo sogs bslab/ sku zhang mkhyen rab chos rje la rnam snang mngon byang sogs kyi dbang sogs gsan/ rgyal mkhar rtse'i bka' bstan gsar bzhengs kyi zhus chen yang mdzad/ sa skyar phebs bdag chen rgya gar ba sku mched las dmar po skor gsum sogs dbang lung 'ga' res gsan/

slob dpon gsal grags las sa sde lnga dang*/ slob dpon rgyal mtshan rdo rje la gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang zhus/ de nas lha sar phebs jo shāka dang*/ bsam yas dang*/ gdan sa mthil rnams mjal/ sne gdong du bdag po kun legs pa'i ngor mtshan brjod kyi 'grel pa dbu ma la dga' bas mdzad pa bsgyur/ dbang lung 'ga' re yang zhus/ gangs dkar rdo rje gdan pa la dbang lung 'ga' zhig zhus/ brtag gnyis skad dod ngo sprod phul/ zhwa dmar spyan snga mjal bdag rkyen bzang po stsal/ stag lung ngag dbang grags pa mjal/ gur gyi rgyud la 'gyur bcos dang sgra'i ri mo sogs phul snga phyir dbang lung 'ga' zhig kyang zhus/ go ram pa las dbu ma 'jug pa'i bshad pa sogs gsan/ spyan snga tshes gnyis pa'i ngor mdzod 'grel 'dod 'jo las 'thus 'gyur mdzad/ zhwa dmar bzhi pa'i thugs bzhed bzhin mdzod 'grel gnam lcags thog zer bsgyur/ rje de nyid kyi drung nas/ mdo ting rgyal/ 'dul ba me tog phreng brgyud/ brgyad stong pa/ mkha' spyod dbang po'i bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs/ mngon 'byung gi mdo/ thar rgyan/ rang byung ba'i bka' 'bum tshang ba/ yu mo'i gsal sgron bzhi/ gser sding pa'i rim lnga'i khrid yig gdams phran bcas/ bu'i rim lnga'i khrid yig /sgron gsal o rgyan pa'i phreng skor gyi lung dang nyams khrid bcas/ mdo sde las brgya/ 'bri khung zab chos sogs dang*/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang sogs gsan/ yar rgyab pa rin chen rnam rgyal gyis spyan drangs nas re zhig e waṃ du bzhugs par zhus/ ka lā pa dang*/ tsān+d+ra pa'i mdo 'grel thugs brtsam mdzad/ 'ga' re la brgyad stong pa'i rgya klog bslab/ don grub rgyal mtshan par ka lā pa'i ri mo stsal/ chos rje dge bzang po las snyan ngag dpag bsam 'khri shing gi lung sogs gsan/ rgya ston lcags ri pa'i gdan sar mnga' gsol/ rgya ston byang chub rnam rgyal las kyang khrid lung mang du gsan/

rje chos grags rgya mtsho mjal/ zab khrid mang po zhus/ grwa thang gi gdan sar mnga' gsol te 'dus sde rnams la dbang chos stsal zhing dus 'khor gyi sgrub mchod btsugs/ lo chen bsod nams rgya mtshor sgra snyan ngag dbang lung sogs gnang*/ de nas zhwa dmar spyan snga'i bla mchan mdzad de gtsang la phebs/ 'jam dpal brda sprod bsgyur/ spyan sngar yang chos khrid du ma phul/ paṇa chen shāka mchog dang*/ rje shākya don grub la chos khrid 'bul ba dang zhu ba yang mdzad/ stag lung du phebs/ sin+dhu'i yi ge'i rgya dpe bklags pas thams cad ha las par gyur/ byams pa gling pa las dus 'khor gyi dbang sogs zhus/ slar yang rje karma pa chos grags rgya mtsho mjal/ phyag chen lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi smin khrid zhus/ mthong bkur chen po gnang*/ de skabs kyi gangs ljongs pa mtha' dag gi slob dpon du mnga' gsol ba'i 'ja' sa dang shel tham gnang*/ re zhig zhabs 'breng mdzad/ smyug la paṇa chen la sgra skor sogs stsal/ karma phrin las pa dang yang gsan bsam 'ga' re mdzad/ slar chag lo rin chen chos rgyal dang mjal shin tu mgu bar mdzad/ rin spungs ngag dbang rnam rgyal dang mjal/ rgya dpe'i steng nas bod skad rnams byang bar stsal bas shin tu mgu bar 'gyur/ de nas zha lu'i gdan sar phebs/ bu ston rin po che'i bzhugs khrir mnga' gsol/ dbang dang chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor/ rtse gdong du phebs/ bdag chen kun dga' bsod nams dang*/ grags pa dpal bzang la dbang lung 'ga' re mdzad/ byams pa gling du phebs chos rje rin po cher rdor phreng dang*/ dus 'khor sogs kyi dbang sogs stsal/ spyan snga chos kyi grags pas bskul nas blo brtan gyi mdzod 'grel dang*/ 'jam dpal brda sprod pa sogs sngon chad bod yul 'dir ma grags pa'i mdo sngags dang*/ rig gnas kyi gzhung mang po bsgyur bar mdzad/ ka tsan gyi bshad sbyar sogs rig gnas lnga sogs kyi bstan bcos kyang mang du mdzad de/

phyis kyi mkhas par grags pa kun kyang rje 'di'i gsung las skyes pa kho nar gyur cing bsngags brjod kyang dpe med pa mdzad 'dug mod rje bla ma'i mkhyen rtogs la dpag na mgron bus mig phyid par dran to//
